CANCELLED FLIGHTS DUE TO #UWANPH 

Typhoon #UwanPH is expected to unleash intense to torrential rains, powerful winds, and wide spread coastal flooding nationwide, local air carriers Philippine Airlines (PR), Cebu Pacific (5J), and Cebgo (DG) cancelled some 25 domestic flights for Sunday, November 9, 2025 and 24 domestic flights for Monday November 10, 2025.

The routes affected are from Manila to Cauayan, Tuguegarao, Virac, Cebu, Masbate, Naga, Calbayog, Clark, and Catarman and its turn-around flights.

The cancellations were made to ensure passenger safety amid strong winds and heavy rains.

The airlines said that affected passengers may choose free rebooking within 30 days, travel fund conversion, or a full refund through their respective websites.

They also advised passengers not to proceed to the airport unless your flight are confirmed to operate. | via Rudy Santos
